definition: A highway is any public street, road, or turnpike that any member of the public has the right to use. A highway is defined in 23 CFR § 924.3 as: 1. A road, street, or parkway and all associated elements such as a right-of-way, bridge, railway-highway crossing, tunnel, drainage structure, sign, markings, guardrail, protective structure, etc.; 2. A roadway facility as may be required by the United States Customs and Immigration Services in connection with the operation of an international bridge or tunnel; and 3. A facility that serves pedestrians and bicyclists pursuant to 23 U.S.C. 148(e)(1)(A).
